status_summary: Executive Order 14162, signed 2025-01-20, revoked the U.S. International Climate Finance Plan and directed the Treasury Secretary, with others, to end U.S. financial commitments under the UN climate convention and report within 30 days. Treasury's Federal Insurance Office left the Network for Greening the Financial System under a statement dated 2025-01-30 that cites that order and Executive Order 14154. On 2025-09-10 the Financial Stability Oversight Council, chaired by the Treasury Secretary, rescinded the charters of its two climate-related financial risk committees. No source found states that the Climate Hub office was closed or that the climate strategic goal was formally replaced, and no Treasury step on Principles for Responsible Investment or on promoting oil and gas investment was found.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14162 revoked the U.S. International Climate Finance Plan and directed the Treasury Secretary, with others, to end U.S. financial commitments under the UN climate convention and report on rescinded policies within 30 days (published 2025-01-30).
Treasury's Federal Insurance Office withdrew from the Network for Greening the Financial System, describing the exit as part of implementing two January 2025 executive orders (reported 2025-02-03).
The Financial Stability Oversight Council rescinded the charters of the Climate-related Financial Risk Committee and the Climate-related Financial Risk Advisory Committee by voice vote.

title: Eliminate the Treasury Climate Hub and reverse climate and ESG finance initiatives
uncertainties: This record combines the Climate Hub, strategic goal, energy investment and ESG items from the same section, since they share one aim; the stage is a judgment across them. The Treasury organization page lists no Climate Hub office but prints no date, so it cannot show when or whether the office closed, and a web search found no report of its closure. The vote day comes from news reports (a Wednesday, 2025-09-10) and the Mintz summary; no FSOC primary document was opened. The Bloomberg Government article is paywalled and was read in part. Treasury's 30-day report under Executive Order 14162 was not found. The Mintz page lists 2025-09-12 as its date although its address contains a 2026 date.
